# Mission Control M0 fixtures

These small manifests and SVG thumbnails are synthetic layout fixtures. They are not derived from telescope observations, do not identify real targets, and must never be cited as scientific results. They exercise state aggregation, provenance links, mobile layout, and the persistent demo badge only.

The fixture set intentionally includes two completed cadence/window pairs, one failed pair, and three verdict labels so the page's explanatory states can be tested. The expected totals are asserted in `tests/test_state.py`.
